name: brake-freeze-holder
note: Ideas 61/71, CMD-08 + F2: the holder freezes for 200 ms (40 ticks) in the middle of the braking ramp, then wakes up. While it is frozen the actuator revokes on its own evidence (MAN-04) and the handover happens; on wake-up A stands down when it reads the STATUT (MAN-08, REL-07) and its stale orders are dropped (ACT-09). The study measures whether the braking ramp survives the freeze-and-return cycle.
